name: Cloudflare Clef for calls that only pick a label
gain: Cloudflare's post says Clef is Jev-API compatible and hosted, in the vendor's words; no independent number recorded here.
how: Point a decision call at the Clef model behind a confidence gate
replaces: A chat call asked to classify, route or score.
trade_offs: Unaudited accuracy; keep a fallback path.
usage_signal: Usage and Cost API: high call count with few output tokens per call

gain_model.formula: calls * (current_cost_per_call - decision_cost_per_call), plus p50 latency difference

inputs.name: calls
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: current_cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: decision_cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

test_recipe.what_to_compare: agreement with the current call, p50 latency, fallback rate

verify_rule: Cost line and p50 for that call over 14 days; fallback rate under the gate

change_recipe.how: Point a decision call at the Clef model behind a confidence gate
change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on

gain_vendor: Cloudflare's post says Clef is Jev-API compatible and hosted, in the vendor's words; no independent number recorded here.
